visual_action: A slideshow of three still photographs of Donald Trump. In each photo, his skin is a very saturated, dark orange color. In the first photo, he points towards the camera with an American flag in the background. In the second, he is speaking at a microphone. In the third, he has a surprised expression on his face while speaking at a podium in front of a crowd.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The entire video consists of still images of Donald Trump.

on_screen_text.text: What's going on with his tan 😭

spoken_summary: A woman's voice, taken from a separate audio source, says, "...who wants to look, you know, simple when you can look stunning?" This is used ironically to comment on Donald Trump's appearance in the photos.
audio_music: An upbeat pop track ('Got It, Give It' by Nat G) plays throughout the video. A spoken audio clip is layered over the music at the beginning. The overall effect of the music and audio combination is lighthearted and mocking.
editing_pacing: The video is a simple slideshow of three still images with basic cuts between them.
manipulation_or_satire: The color saturation of the images appears to be heavily increased to exaggerate the orange tone of Donald Trump's skin, mocking his tan.
cultural_references: The audio clip "who wants to look... simple when you can look stunning" is from Jennifer Aydin on the reality TV show 'The Real Housewives of New Jersey'.
central_claim: Donald Trump's tan is comically extreme and worthy of ridicule.
intended_effect: To make the viewer laugh at Donald Trump and view his appearance as absurd.
